title: Every convex body in R^3 is covered by 13 smaller homothetic copies (H_3 <= 13)
description: Computer-assisted proof of the Hadwiger covering bound H_3 <= 13. Exact linear-programming certificate checked by two separately written exact checkers; the reduction from the certificate to the theorem is formalised in Lean 4, with the certificate check as a stated axiom. Checkers, Lean project, hashes and a sample; the full certificate is in a separate Zenodo dataset named in the README. AI-generated under Lee Marshall's direction; not peer reviewed.
